info.description: This API contains endpoints to fetch Mii data from NNID, CMOC, or Miitomo and an endpoint to render a Mii icon. As of writing, the repo for the renderer server is located here: https://github.com/ariankordi/FFL-Testing/tree/renderer-server-prototype and for the frontend/APIs itself is located here: https://github.com/ariankordi/nwf-mii-cemu-toy/tree/ffl-renderer-proto-integrate If you are lurking and found this, my email address is ariankordi@ariankordi.net
info.title: Mii Renderer (REAL) Frontend and API

get.description: Looks up a CMOC entry number from the Check Mii Out Channel and returns its Mii data as 76 byte RFLStoreData/.rsd format. As of writing this code, it's retrieving from WiiLink: https://miicontest.wiilink.ca

parameters.description: CMOC Entry Number (we will descramble it)
parameters.name: cmoc_code

200.description: Base64 encoded RFLStoreData (76 bytes) or binary data if requesting with Accept: application/octet-stream

get.description: Retrieves Mii data from a Nintendo/Pretendo NNID or PID. Note that this uses a local archive database for NNID data.

parameters.description: NNID/user ID. Also works as a query parameter that allows multiple comma separated values.
parameters.name: nnid

parameters.description: PID. Can be used without nnid path parameter and allows multiple comma separated values.
parameters.name: pid

parameters.description: API ID. Set to 1 to look up a Pretendo Network ID. This was originally intended for working with multiple NNID environments, which is why it's like this.
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.description: Force refresh. Bypasses cache when fetching.
parameters.name: force_refresh

200.description: NNID data including Mii data, will return an array if multiple NNIDs are requested. Mii data is 96 byte FFLStoreData in Base64, but if you are requesting one NNID, it will be returned as binary if you request with Accept: application/octet-stream.

get.description: Renders a Mii image based on provided data, NNID, or PID. Also supports exporting a 3D model of the head to binary glTF (.glb).

parameters.description: Mii data in hex or Base64. Accepts many different types, but the data is detected based on its length.
parameters.name: data

parameters.description: Expression - NOTE that for glTF export, this accepts multiple comma separated values.
parameters.name: expression

parameters.description: Upscale Factor - Set to 1 for no upscaling
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: Instance Count (Rotation) - NOTE that, for the moment, the extra instances are stacked vertically.
parameters.name: instanceCount

parameters.format: string, 6 digit hex with hash/8 digit for RGBA
parameters.name: bgColor

200.description: Model rendered to png, tga, or binary glTF (.glb)

get.description: Get data (e.g. nn::mii::CoreData, Mii image...) from a player on Miitomo (Kaerutomo) by their player ID. As of writing, this is requesting the following API endpoint: ktp.kaeru.world/v1/player/get_player_data

parameters.description: Player ID. This is in your friend request invite link as the first 16 character hex string after friend_code/
parameters.name: player_id

parameters.description: Target player ID. Accepts multiple comma separated values. This works in substitute of the player ID path parameter.
parameters.name: target_player_id

parameters.description: Namespace. Accepts multiple comma separated values. Known values: own_mii, stock_mii, mii_face_image, account_info, stock_item, reported_content, corinth_status, star_account_info, _star_account_info, message_info
parameters.name: namespace

200.description: Player data returned from the upstream.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Error with marshaling, obfuscating, or sending request.

last_modified.description: this is only a pointer so that omitempty will work
